policy.authority: Benchmark targets are the future source of truth. Evidence Kit is a legacy import/report archive during migration.
policy.benchmarkCode: Benchmark implementation lives with the runtime/package code it measures.
policy.activeLoops: Autoresearch sessions optimize one target id at a time and own only active loop state.
policy.docs: Docs and research files are linked evidence, not benchmark control state.
